title: Top exterior power is invertible
statement: the top exterior power of a finite locally free sheaf is locally isomorphic to the structure sheaf.

proof.text: Use the finite locally free rank-$r$ hypothesis [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module] and the proved library theorem Scheme.Modules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.exists_restrict_iso_free to obtain an open cover $U_i$ with trivializations $\mathcal M|_{U_i}\cong\mathcal O_{U_i}^{\oplus r}$. Each point belongs to some member of the cover.

Apply [lem-sc-exterior-sheaf-trivial-top-iso] to each trivialization. Sheafify its presheaf isomorphism; the invertible counit of the sheafification adjunction identifies the sheafification of the structure presheaf with the structure sheaf.

Compose [lem-sc-exterior-sheaf-restrict-iso] with the preceding isomorphism. The standard restrictFunctorIsoPullback comparison converts the restriction to the pullback along the open inclusion. For every point this gives the open neighbourhood and isomorphism to the unit demanded by scheme-module invertibility.

theorem exteriorSheaf_top_isInvertible {X : Scheme.{v}} (M : X.Modules) (r : ℕ)
